title: Hearty Smoky Russian Cheese Grill
description: A solo dinner Russian dish featuring maple syrup and double rise bread, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill. This dish is salty, cheesy, and perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium heat.
Slice the double rise bread into 1 inch thick slices.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place the bread slices butter side down on the grill.
Sprinkle the Russian cheese over the bread slices.
Drizzle the maple syrup over the cheese.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper over the cheese.
Close the grill lid and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted.
Flip the bread slices over and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the bread slices from the grill and sprinkle with chopped fresh dill.
